articles.title: Alaska's Fat Bear Week Returns with Record Number of Cubs
articles.summary: Sixteen brown bears in Katmai National Park are competing to be the fattest before winter. With 37 cubs counted this year, the bracket is bigger than ever. Voting starts September 22, and last year's champion, Chunk, is back.

articles.title: AI Giants Face Antitrust Lawsuit Over Alleged Slowdown Agreement
articles.summary: A new lawsuit claims Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, and Google illegally agreed to slow AI development. The suit, filed Friday, says this hurts consumers who pay for AI subscriptions. The companies have not yet commented.

articles.title: Trump Bans CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from White House
articles.summary: President Trump banned three major news outlets from the White House, and reporters' badges were seized. The outlets call it unconstitutional and vow to fight. Press freedom groups say the ban is illegal.
